name: Telangana retrieval benchmark
labelling: All expected labels are machine-generated candidates written from provision headings and source text, with passages copied verbatim from the indexed chunks. None is human-confirmed. A reviewer sets reviewer_status to 'human_confirmed' (or 'human_rejected') after checking the case against the original source, and fills reviewed_by and reviewed_on.
